newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark in Swedish, Dutch deals.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark in Swedish, Dutch deals.

text.p: COPENHAGEN, Feb 21 (Reuter) Danish telecoms group Tele Danmark said on Friday that it had agreed to give Swedish operator Nordiska Tele8 and Belnet Holland of the Netherlands access to its domestic network, allowing them to offer international services to Danish subscribers.

Under Danish deregulation rules introduced last July, 51.73 percent state-owned Tele Denmark, a former monopoly, is obliged to rent access to its network to competitors. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
